description:
**Job Title:** Senior Human Resources Manager

**Department:** Human Resources

**Experience:** 6\+ years

**Location:** Officer no. 606, Sixth floor, Motia Royal Business Park, Zirakpur

**Reporting To:** Director

We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Senior HR professional** to lead and manage all human resource functions within the organization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **HR policies, company rules \& regulations, employee engagement, compliance, performance management, recruitment, and HR operations**.

The Senior HR will play a key role in **developing HR policies, ensuring legal compliance, improving workplace culture, and aligning HR strategies with business objectives**.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities\-**

**1\. HR Policy Development \& Implementation**

* Develop, implement, and update **HR policies, procedures, and company regulations**.
* Create and maintain **employee handbooks, SOPs, and HR guidelines**.
* Ensure policies comply with **labor laws, company ethics, and industry standards**.
* Regularly review HR policies and recommend improvements.
* Communicate policies effectively to employees and management.

**2\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**

* Lead the **end\-to\-end recruitment process** including job posting, screening, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Work with department heads to identify **staffing needs and hiring plans**.
* Develop strategies to attract and retain **high\-quality talent**.
* Maintain recruitment databases and candidate pipelines.

**3\. Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Maintain a positive **work environment and organizational culture**.
* Address employee grievances, conflicts, and disciplinary matters.
* Develop **employee engagement programs, team\-building activities, and wellness initiatives**.
* Conduct **employee satisfaction surveys** and take improvement actions.

**4\. Performance Management**

* Develop and implement **performance appraisal systems**.
* Monitor employee performance and ensure alignment with company goals.
* Guide managers in **performance reviews and improvement plans**.
* Support employee growth through **training and development programs**.

**5\. HR Compliance \& Legal**

* Ensure compliance with **labor laws, employment regulations, and statutory requirements**.
* Maintain records related to **employee documentation, contracts, and compliance reports**.
* Handle **disciplinary actions, warnings, and termination processes** as per company policy.
* Conduct internal audits to ensure HR compliance.

**6\. Payroll \& Compensation Management**

* Oversee payroll processing in coordination with finance.
* Ensure accuracy in **salary structures, deductions, benefits, and incentives**.
* Manage employee benefits programs including **insurance, leave policies, and bonuses**.
* Review compensation structures to maintain **market competitiveness**.

**7\. Training \& Development**

* Identify training needs and organize **employee development programs**.
* Design and implement **leadership and skill development initiatives**.
* Monitor training effectiveness and employee growth.

**8\. HR Strategy \& Organizational Development**

* Develop HR strategies aligned with **company goals and business growth**.
* Assist leadership in **organizational planning and workforce planning**.
* Improve HR processes through **automation and efficient HR systems**.
* Support management in decision\-making related to **human capital**.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of **HR policies, labor laws, and compliance**.
* Excellent **leadership and team management skills**.
* Strong **communication and interpersonal abilities**.
* Expertise in **conflict resolution and employee relations**.
* Ability to handle **confidential information with integrity**.
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in **HR software and MS Office tools**.

Interested candidates can share their resumes on **hr@voyagetripplanner.com** or whats app on **9910997162\.**

title: HR Manager
description:
**OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a hands\-on HR Manager to independently own the entire people function for a growing team operating across India and the UAE. This is not a corporate HR role — you will be building HR infrastructure from the ground up in a fast\-paced startup environment.

You will handle everything from recruiting and onboarding to payroll coordination, performance management, compliance, employee engagement, and exit management. We need someone who combines strong HR fundamentals with startup pragmatism — someone who can draft a proper employment contract AND have a tough conversation about performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Recruitment \& Onboarding**

Manage end\-to\-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, and background verification. Execute structured onboarding with Day 1 checklists, tool access, policy walkthroughs, and 30\-day check\-ins.

**Payroll \& Compliance**

Coordinate monthly payroll processing and verification. Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws (PF, ESI, PT) and UAE labor law basics. Maintain audit\-ready employee records and documentation.

**Performance Management**

Implement review cycles: goal setting, check\-ins, and quarterly/annual reviews. Manage PIPs with proper documentation. Coordinate salary reviews and increments based on performance data.

**Employee Engagement**

Conduct monthly 1\-on\-1 check\-ins with all employees. Plan team activities and recognition programs. Manage grievances with confidentiality. Run quarterly engagement surveys.

**Policy \& Reporting**

Maintain the Employee Handbook and HR policies. Deliver monthly HR dashboards: headcount, attrition, open positions, payroll costs. Benchmark compensation against market data.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must\-Have**

* 3–7 years of HR generalist experience, with at least 1–2 years managing HR independently for a small company (10–50 employees).
* Hands\-on experience with Indian payroll, PF, ESI, and labor compliance.
* Proven recruitment experience: personally hired 15\+ employees across technical and non\-technical roles.
* Experience managing performance reviews, PIPs, and difficult employee conversations.
* Strong documentation skills: employment contracts, policies, and professional communications.
* Proficiency in HR tools (HRMS/HRIS) and Excel for payroll and reporting.
* Excellent English communication (written and verbal).
* High integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Experience with UAE labor law (MOHRE, WPS, visa processing).
* Experience in an IT services or SaaS startup environment.
* HR certification (SHRM\-CP, PHR, or Indian equivalent).
* Experience managing distributed/remote teams across countries.
* MBA in HR or equivalent qualification.

title: HR & Admin Executive
description:
**About RAS Luxury Skincare**

RAS Luxury Skincare is a premium, science\-backed skincare brand rooted in the belief that real ingredients deliver real results. We are a lean, high\-performing team where every individual — including our founders — rolls up their sleeves and gets things done. Our culture is collaborative, ego\-free, and deeply invested in excellence at every level.

**Role Overview**

This is a one\-person powerhouse role. The Senior Executive – HR, Admin \& Operations is the backbone of the Mumbai office — responsible for keeping the workplace running seamlessly, building a great team, and ensuring every employee has a positive experience from Day 1\.

This role requires someone who is equally comfortable writing a recruitment brief, onboarding a new joiner, resolving a laptop issue, and stepping in to make sure a cabin is set up correctly before an important meeting. At RAS, no task is beneath anyone — our founders and senior leadership lead by example in this regard, and we expect the same from this role.

**A Note on Culture \& Mindset**

At RAS, we believe that the best leaders are hands\-on. Whether it is our founders or a VP, no one considers any task too small if it serves the team or the brand. A few examples of what this looks like in practice:

On office \& operations: If the housekeeping staff has missed placing water glasses in a cabin before a meeting, our Senior Executive does not escalate or wait — they place the glasses themselves and then address the root cause with the housekeeper afterwards.

On recruitment: If a strong candidate has not heard back in three days and is likely to drop off, our Senior Executive does not wait for a reminder from the hiring manager — they pick up the phone, keep the candidate warm, and follow up internally to get a decision. A good candidate lost to slow process is a failure we take personally.

On onboarding: If a new joiner's laptop is not ready on Day 1, our Senior Executive does not shrug and say the IT vendor is delayed — they arrange an interim solution, sit with the joiner through their first\-day setup, and make sure the person feels genuinely welcomed, not just processed. First impressions of a company are set in the first 48 hours.

On making people feel secure: Employees should never feel like they are in the dark about where they stand. Our Senior Executive proactively checks in — especially with newer team members — to ensure they feel supported, heard, and clear on expectations. A settled, secure team performs better. That is not soft work; it is strategic.

On performance \& feedback: This role is also a trusted channel for the leadership team. If someone on the team is underperforming, struggling, or creating friction, our Senior Executive is expected to have honest, constructive conversations — both to support the individual and to keep leadership informed. This requires courage, tact, and complete confidentiality. It is not about managing people out; it is about helping people grow, and being clear when growth is not happening.

**This is not an exception; it is an expectation. If you bring ego to this role, this is not the right place for you. If you bring ownership, empathy, and the courage to do hard things well — you will thrive here.**

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

– Own end\-to\-end recruitment: write JDs, post on relevant platforms, source candidates, screen resumes

– Shortlist candidates based on role fitment and coordinate interview schedules with hiring managers

– Coordinate and confirm all interview logistics — in\-person and virtual

– Ensure timely follow\-up with candidates at every stage; maintain a positive candidate experience

– Collect structured interview feedback from the reporting manager within 24 hours of each interview

– Maintain a recruitment tracker and provide weekly status updates to leadership

– Build a pipeline of passive candidates for recurring roles

2\. Onboarding \& Induction

– Execute a structured, warm, and professional onboarding experience for every new joiner

– Prepare offer letters, employment documentation, and Day 1 readiness kits

– Coordinate system access, ID cards, workstation setup, and equipment allocation before the joining date

– Conduct the induction session covering company history, culture, values, team introductions, and policies

– Ensure the new joiner meets all key stakeholders in the first week

– Schedule 30\-day and 60\-day check\-ins and capture early feedback from both joiner and reporting manager

3\. Employee Welfare, Engagement \& Grievance Handling

– Be the go\-to person for employees with concerns, queries, or requests — approachable and discreet

– Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations, and milestone events

– Maintain a calendar of birthdays, work anniversaries, and team events

– Handle grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality; escalate to leadership only when truly necessary

– Gather periodic pulse feedback from employees and share actionable insights with leadership

– Ensure HR policies are clearly communicated and consistently applied

4\. Scheduling \& Coordination

– Manage interview scheduling, induction calendars, and leadership meeting coordination

– Handle logistics for internal events, offsite meetings, and team gatherings

– Maintain accurate records: attendance, leave, HR documentation, vendor contracts

– Prepare and share regular reports on open positions, headcount, and admin status with leadership

5\. Administration \& Facility Management

– Ensure the Mumbai office is clean, well\-stocked, and fully operational at all times

– Manage housekeeping staff — set daily task schedules, conduct spot checks, and hold them accountable for quality

– Be the first line of response for any facility issue: if something is not right, fix it first and investigate second

– Manage vendor relationships: office supplies, pantry, maintenance, courier, utilities

– Maintain office inventory and raise purchase requests proactively — never let the office run out of essentials

– Coordinate asset allocation and maintenance (furniture, equipment, appliances)

– Ensure meeting rooms and cabins are set up correctly before every meeting — water, stationery, AV, cleanliness

6\. IT Support \& Coordination

– Be the first point of contact for day\-to\-day IT issues: connectivity, software access, hardware problems

– Coordinate with external IT vendors for resolution of issues that require specialised support

– Manage software licenses, tool subscriptions, and access management for the office

– Ensure all new joiners have fully configured systems and required software access on Day 1

– Maintain an asset register for all IT equipment and ensure timely servicing or replacement

description:
A Linux engineer is a systems expert responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining Linux\-based infrastructure to support enterprise applications, networks, and services. These professionals ensure servers are secure, performant, and highly available, often working behind the scenes to keep business\-critical systems running smoothly. Linux engineers play a key role in infrastructure automation, patching, incident response, and environment monitoring, serving as subject matter experts for open\-source platforms.

They typically work with distributions like Red Hat, Ubuntu, or CentOS and are skilled in scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or Perl. Linux engineers automate system provisioning and configuration using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet and frequently manage deployments across hybrid or cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP. Their responsibilities span OS\-level troubleshooting, performance optimization, log analysis, and supporting CI/CD pipelines and containerized services.

description:

--------------


Hiring is still stuck in the past. Manual screening. Unconscious bias. Candidates are waiting weeks for feedback. Organizations drown in admin work instead of finding real talent.

**We're fixing that with AI that works.**


Talview builds Gen AI\-powered solutions that make hiring and assessment faster, fairer, and scalable. We automate the busy work—interview scheduling, candidate screening, exam proctoring—so organizations can focus on what matters: discovering great people.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one—your mentors will help you grow.

✅ Full\-time potential Strong performers often convert to full\-time roles post\-internship

We're built on **Collaboration, Commitment, Credence (trust), Customer\-centricity, and Candor**. Translation? We work together, ship quality, trust each other, obsess over users, and keep it real.

Our team includes off\-roaders, bikers, table tennis champions, cricketers, marathon runners, musicians, gamers, and pretty much every flavor of human. We have thriving families and happy singles. You'll find your crew here—and you're welcome to bring talented friends along.

title: HR Generalist
description:
As our HR Generalist, you will be the backbone of our HR \& Talent Acquisition operations and the support to the Head of HR. In this role, you will take ownership of our operational framework, ensuring that every process, from drafting contracts to managing precise monthly payroll, is executed timely and accurately. By managing BambooHR and taking ownership of our recruitment workflows, you ensure that our administrative processes are consistently accurate and our data remains reliable for all daily operations.

  

This role is primarily office\-based to support collaboration, teamwork, and visibility across the organisation. The HR Generalist is expected to work from the office 4 days per week, with 1 day per week working from home.

 **Key Responsibilities**


**Talent Acquisition Execution**


* Manage the full\-cycle recruitment process for all open roles, from initial sourcing on job boards, to conducting screenings and coordinating hiring manager interviews.
* Draft and maintain accurate job descriptions and ensure all vacancies are posted on relevant industry boards and the JOI Careers page.
* Manage the candidate pipeline within BambooHR, ensuring timely feedback and a professional candidate experience.
* Conduct pre\-employment due diligence, including reference checks and right\-to\-work verifications.

  


**HR Operations \& Compliance**


* Serve as the administrator for BambooHR, ensuring all employee data, digital files, and lifecycle changes (promotions, salary adjustments) are 100% accurate.
* Manage all local statutory requirements, including the timely filing of engagement and termination forms.
* Draft employment contracts, addenda, and termination letters in strict accordance with local legislation and GDPR.
* Oversee the offboarding process, ensuring the recovery of company assets and completion of statutory documentation.

  


**Payroll Preparation \& Benefits Administration**


* Prepare the monthly pay\-run by collecting data on leave, bonuses, salary changes, etc., liaising directly with the external payroll providers and Finance team.
* Administer all employee benefits, including, but not limited to, monetary allowances and occupational pension scheme.
* Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding payroll queries, policy clarifications, and leave entitlements.

  


**Benefits**


* €1,000 Annual Wellness Allowance.
* Relocation package available for those joining us from abroad.
* Wellness \& Work\-Life Balance
* Employee Assistance Program \- €250 per annum
* Birthday Leave – enjoy an extra day off to celebrate your special day
* Anniversary Leave – enjoy an extra day for every year at Joi Gaming.
* Friday Drinks \& Lunch – a weekly get\-together to connect with your team
* Hybrid work – 1 day from home per week after your 6\-month probation
* Remote work abroad – work from anywhere for up to 1 month per year
* Free parking for cars and motorbikes

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Share cv on hrd@naari.network

Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage end\-to\-end recruitment and onboarding for our growing building materials manufacturing company.

The role involves sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates across various functions including sales, technical, operations, and corporate roles. The candidate should be organized, proactive, and capable of managing multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle from job posting to offer rollout
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, and referrals
* Screen profiles and conduct initial HR interviews
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate pipelines

2\. Stakeholder Coordination

* Work closely with department heads and hiring managers
* Understand role requirements and hiring priorities
* Ensure smooth interview scheduling and feedback collection

3\. Offer \& Onboarding

* Manage offer rollout and salary discussions
* Handle documentation and joining formalities
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new employees

4\. Recruitment Planning \& Reporting

* Track open positions and hiring progress
* Maintain candidate databases
* Provide regular recruitment updates to management

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who:

* Has strong recruitment and coordination skills
* Can manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously
* Is comfortable interacting with candidates and internal stakeholders
* Is proactive with follow\-ups and hiring closure

Qualification

Preferred:

* MBA / PGDM in HR / BBA / relevant HR qualification

Experience:

* 2–5 years experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
* Experience hiring for sales, technical, and operational roles
* Experience with job portals like Indeed, Naukri, LinkedIn etc.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Timely closure of open positions
* Quality of candidates hired
* Smooth onboarding experience
* Efficient recruitment coordination

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

* Current CTC

* Which job portals or sourcing platforms have you used for recruitment?
* Have you previously handled recruitment for multiple roles simultaneously (sales, technical, operations etc.)?
* How many positions do you typically handle at the same time?

title: Jr. HR Associate (Talent Acquisition)
description:
**Be part of a high\-performing Recruitment team at one of America's fastest growing companies**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



This is Riza, the HR Manager at Fresh Prints.



If you had asked me five years ago whether I'd be leading recruitment, running cross\-functional projects, managing a team of talented HR Associates, building automations (despite coming from a non\-tech background), spearheading QA, and writing OKRs – all things that were completely alien to me at the time, I would've laughed and probably rolled my eyes.



I joined Fresh Prints during COVID as a fresh graduate, as part of a newly formed HR team, viewing it as a stepping stone before heading to business school. That plan took a sharp U\-turn when I was given opportunities to do far more than just "screen resumes" – to think critically about hiring, build systems, and help redefine what recruiting could look like in a fast\-growing startup.



I doubted myself at almost every step, but I took on the challenge to build a high\-functioning team and to redefine recruiting in a way that actually supports the business.



Almost five years in, we're a strong team of dedicated talent specialists spread across India and the Philippines. We've hired and retained over 400 employees in the past few years and learned a ton along the way; what scales, what breaks, and what truly moves the needle.



We're an experiment\-first team. We don't flinch at ideas, we love them. Have a compelling idea? Pitch it. We'll run with it. We're equally big on learning and iteration, and today, nearly 50% of our workflows are automated, freeing our talent associates to focus on strategy and execution.



Now, we're looking for strategists who execute. People who go beyond ticking off daily tasks and think about the bigger picture:


* How can HR enable the business?
* How can HR better support the Executive Team?
* How can HR lead world\-class talent acquisition that creates a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers?


If this sounds exciting, and you have the energy to build, experiment, and own outcomes, I'd love to hear from you.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**



As a member of our Recruitment team, you're going to have a wide\-ranging group of responsibilities and goals. On a day\-to\-day basis, this means:


* Lead prospecting and headhunting efforts. Not just finding the right candidates, but nurturing relationships early and building long\-term pipelines
* Source candidates from diverse channels and screen resumes and applications with a strong quality bar
* Take hands\-on ownership of role coordination that goes beyond scheduling (much of which is automated) to stay closely involved in progress, blockers, and outcomes for each role
* Conduct interviews and coordinate multiple rounds of assessments
* Partner closely with hiring managers to align on role expectations, feedback, and hiring timelines
* Communicate clearly with management and team members to provide regular status updates
* Take on additional responsibilities as needed in a fast\-moving startup environment


**Qualifications:**


* Preferably 1\.5\+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment
* Freshers are highly encouraged to apply
* Strong attention to detail with relentless follow\-up
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Experience in a start\-up environment is a huge plus
* Experience with in\-house recruitment is preferred


**Job Location:** Work From Home / Remote


**Working Hours:** 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST, Monday to Friday


**CTC:** Between $400 to $700, with a night allowance of $40

  



At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long\-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2\-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.


**Fresh Prints never charges any money during the hiring process. If you're asked to pay for a job, it's not real.**


***Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity; actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ\+, and those with disabilities to apply.***

**Roles and Responsibilities – Headend Engineer**

The Headend Engineer will be responsible for the day\-to\-day technical operations and maintenance of the headend systems to ensure uninterrupted broadcast and signal delivery. Key responsibilities include:

* **Satellite Dish Management** \- Installation, alignment, and maintenance of satellite dishes to ensure optimal signal reception.

* **IF (Intermediate Frequency) Distribution \-** Managing IF signal distribution across various systems in the headend.
* **Pay Channel Box Handling \-** Configuration and periodic maintenance of pay channel decoders/boxes.
* **PSI/SI Table Management \-**Monitoring and updating of Program Specific Information (PSI) and Service Information (SI) tables for accurate program listing and signal decoding.
* **Transport Stream (TS) Playout \-** Supervision of TS playout systems ensuring smooth and synchronized content transmission.
* **Physical Monitoring of Set\-Top Boxes (STBs) \-** Regular inspection and performance tracking of all deployed STBs.
* **CAS (Conditional Access System) Dashboard Monitoring \-** Real\-time monitoring of CAS dashboards to ensure subscriber access control and security.
* **Entitlement \& De\-entitlement Activities \-** Performing entitlement and de\-entitlement functions periodically as per operational requirements.

description:
**Job Profile: Plant Technician / Floor Assistant**

**Reporting to:** Lead CNC Operator / Production Manager / Welder/Fitter

**Objective:** To serve as a versatile technical resource on the production floor, ensuring seamless material flow, machine uptime, and supporting the senior fabrication team in achieving IRS/DNV Class\-certified output.

**1\. Detailed Scope of Work**

**A. CNC \& Forming Support:**

* **Material Staging:** Use the overhead crane to fetch and position 8m x 3m marine\-grade steel plates on the **Pro\-Arc Plasma** bed.
* **Post\-Cut Processing:** Immediately remove cut parts from the "skeleton" (scrap), perform edge\-grinding and de\-burring to prepare components for the welding stage.
* **Hydraulic Press Support:** Assist the operator in manual handling and positioning of large\-format A60/B15 panels during the **300T "Single\-Stroke"** forming process.

**B. Fabrication \& Assembly Support:**

* **Joint Preparation:** Prepare weld joints for the **6G Welders** by cleaning surfaces and grinding bevels to strict "contamination\-free" standards.
* **Assembly Assistance:** Hold, clamp, and align heavy door frames and hatches during the "fitting" process; assist in installing heavy\-duty hinges and locking "dogs."
* **Finishing:** Perform final slag removal, polishing, and buffing of finished products to meet Naval aesthetic and anti\-corrosion standards.

**C. Shop Floor Maintenance \& Asset Care:**

* **Daily Maintenance:** Execute the "First\-Hour" checklist (coolant levels, lubrication, air pressure) for all 4 major machines before the shift starts.
* **Scrap Monetization Support:** Systematically segregate and stack steel off\-cuts by grade (Grade A vs. DH36\) for efficient scrap recovery.
* **5S Compliance:** Maintain a clean and hazard\-free workspace; ensure welding gases and tools are stored safely to meet **IRS/DNV audit** standards.

**2\. Minimum Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** **ITI (Fitter / Machinist / Welder)** or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 1–3 years in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment. (High\-aptitude freshers with strong blueprint reading skills are also eligible).
* **Aptitude:** Must be physically fit and capable of safely operating overhead cranes and heavy power tools.

**3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Machine Setup Speed:** Reducing the "idle time" between CNC runs by ensuring material is ready and loaded promptly.
* **Prep\-Quality:** Zero rejections from senior welders due to poor edge preparation or grinding errors.
* **Safety \& Cleanliness:** Achieving 100% compliance in the monthly "Safety \& 5S" internal audit.

description:
**Job Category:** Marketing
**Job Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Remote
Redhoney is a digital marketing agency focused on improving client performance. As we continue to grow, we seek an experienced Digital Ads Manager with a proven track record preferably in an agency setting to lead high\-impact digital advertising campaigns.


#### **Role Overview**


An SEO executive is responsible for optimizing a website to improve its visibility in search engine results, driving organic traffic and supporting business growth.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Keyword Research: SEO Executives identify the most effective keywords for content and website optimization by analyzing search volume, competition, and user intent using tools like Google Keyword Planner, SEMrush, or Ahrefs. This research informs content strategy and helps target the right audience at the right time.
* On\-Page SEO: They optimize website elements such as title tags, meta descriptions, headings, image alt texts, and internal linking. Ensuring a responsive, user\-friendly layout and proper keyword placement improves both search engine rankings and user experience.
* Technical SEO: SEO Executives manage backend website elements to enhance crawlability and indexing. Tasks include fixing crawl errors, improving site speed, managing redirects, ensuring mobile responsiveness, and implementing schema markup for better visibility.
* Content Collaboration: They work closely with content writers, designers, and marketers to create SEO\-friendly content that aligns with search intent, engages users, and drives conversions. This includes optimizing blogs, landing pages, and product pages.
* Off\-Page SEO and Link Building: Building high\-quality backlinks and improving website authority are key responsibilities. SEO Executives evaluate link opportunities and monitor competitor strategies to strengthen the site’s credibility.
* Analytics and Reporting: Monitoring website performance using tools like Google Analytics, they track traffic, rankings, and other KPIs. They produce reports and provide actionable recommendations to improve SEO outcomes.
* Continuous Learning and Strategy Adjustment: SEO is dynamic, so executives must stay updated on search engine algorithm changes and industry trends, adjusting strategies to maintain or improve rankings.
* Collaboration and Cross\-Functional Work: SEO Executives often coordinate with web developers, marketing teams, and digital strategists to ensure SEO best practices are implemented across all content and technical aspects of the website.

#### **Key Skills**


* SEO Analysis

* Content Writing / Editing

title: Social Political Content Researcher
description:
**Role Objective**

The Social\-Political Content Researcher is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and contextualizing the most important political and social stories of the day. You won't just find the news; you will find the "story behind the story." Your research will fuel scripts for videos, long\-form articles, and social media campaigns that aim to inform and engage the public.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Trend Analysis:** Monitor legislative changes, election updates, and social movements to identify "viral" potential and civic importance.
* **Fact\-Checking \& Verification:** Cross\-reference political claims with official gazettes, parliamentary records (like Sansad TV/PRS), and historical data.
* **Narrative Building:** Transform complex policies (e.g., GST changes, New Education Policy) into simple, relatable content "hooks" for the creative team.
* **Data Visualization Support:** Gather statistics and "clean" data to help graphic designers create charts and infographics.
* **Sourcing Experts:** Identify and reach out to professors, activists, and analysts for exclusive quotes or deep\-dive interviews.
* **Archive Management:** Maintain a "Political Encyclopedia" of past speeches, manifesto promises, and flip\-flops for quick\-reference "then vs. now" content.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Educational Background:** Degree in Political Science, Sociology, Journalism, or Law.
* **Analytical Depth:** Ability to read between the lines of a government press release or a politician's tweet.
* **Platform Knowledge:** Mastery of Twitter (X), Instagram, and Reddit as research tools (understanding "Internet Culture").
* **Languages:** Native\-level fluency in **Hindi** and professional proficiency in **English** is mandatory. Knowledge of a regional language is a huge plus.
* **Tools:** Familiarity with Google Trends, TweetDeck, and basic data tools (Excel/Google Sheets).

**The Ideal Candidate**

* You follow the **Election Commission** and **Supreme Court** updates as closely as most people follow IPL.
* You understand the nuances of "Left," "Right," and "Center" without letting personal bias cloud your research.
* You can work under the "Breaking News" pressure where accuracy cannot be sacrificed for speed.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹180,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
**About Lokal :**
 In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier\-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
   

  

 This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place \& one app \- local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight \- when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies \& marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
   

  

 Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
   

  

 to connect Tier\-2/3\+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.
   

  

 We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
   

  

* Edutainment \& Skill Learning \- practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking \- hyperlocal, compatibility\-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting \- farmer\-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs \- blue\- and grey\-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social \& Community \- Place to find \& post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well\-being \& Peer Support \- safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt \& Eaze)
* Astrology \& Guidance \- instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services \- early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more


 Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local\-language internet \+ deep Bharat insight\+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
   

  

 This is the story new teammates walk into:
   

  

 a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
   

  

 We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
   

  

**Requirements**
**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated and detail\-oriented
 **HR Intern \- Data \& Reporting Focus** 
 to support our HR team in managing data, preparing reports, and creating insightful dashboards. This role is ideal for candidates who are strong in data handling, presentation skills, and have hands\-on experience with AI tools.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Collect, organize, and maintain HR\-related data (recruitment, attendance, performance, etc.)
* Prepare accurate and timely HR reports and dashboards for management review
* Design professional presentations and reports using PowerPoint
* Assist in analyzing workforce trends and generating insights
* Utilize AI tools to improve reporting, automation, and data processing
* Support HR operations and administrative tasks as required
* Ensure data confidentiality and compliance with company policies


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in HR, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field
* Strong data handling and analytical skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Ability to create clear and visually appealing reports and dashboards
* Hands\-on experience with AI tools for data analysis, reporting, or automation
* Good attention to detail and organizational skills
* Strong communication and presentation abilities


**Preferred Skills (Optional)**
* Knowledge of HR metrics and KPIs
* Experience with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
* Basic understanding of HR systems (HRIS)


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 We're scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you'll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

 Jefferies Financial Group Inc. (‘‘Jefferies,’’ ‘‘we,’’ ‘‘us’’ or ‘‘our’’) is a U.S.\-headquartered global full service, integrated investment banking and securities firm. Our largest subsidiary, Jefferies LLC, a U.S. broker\-dealer, was founded in the U.S. in 1962 and our first international operating subsidiary, Jefferies International Limited, a U.K. broker\-dealer, was established in the U.K. in 1986\. We offer deep sector expertise across a full range of products and services in investment banking, equities, fixed income, asset and wealth management in the Americas, Europe and the Middle East and Asia.
 



  





**Position: HRBP \- Associate (Based in Express Towers, Mumbai)** 




**Description:** 
 The HRBP\- Associate will be responsible for delivering proactive and high\-quality operational HR support to Jefferies India. The candidate will support the overall Jefferies India HR Head in providing a variety of HR services to the business. The HR Business Partner will act as a trusted advisor and will provide support to the business across the full range of HR disciplines such as recruitment including campus recruitment support, onboarding, performance management, compensation and benefits, regulatory reporting and audit requirements, employee relations, talent development and employee engagement.

* Support the onboarding and offboarding process for both voluntary and involuntary terminations.

* Foster cultural engagement by helping organize team\-building events and volunteer initiatives to strengthen cross\-team connectivity.
* Conduct new hire check\-ins to facilitate integration, address challenges, and gather feedback on the employee experience.
* Help drive the year\-end promotions process by managing timelines, tracking global nominations, compiling year\-over\-year statistics, and overseeing communications.
* Manage employee relations cases as required in partnership with HR management and employment legal counsel.

* Strong Excel skills required (must be fluent in formulas such as VLOOKUP, PivotTables, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, MIN, MAX, AVERAGE).

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Precise attention to detail and strong process orientation and project management skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a client service mindset.
* Positive attitude with a desire to learn and grow.
* Demonstrates sound judgment, professionalism and assertiveness with the ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Collaborative team player who takes initiative and proactively contributes ideas and recommendations.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity work environment.



  





 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives.  JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Human Resources professional with a strong focus on recruitment and talent acquisition. The ideal candidate will play a key role in identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent across multiple functions while ensuring an efficient and positive candidate experience. This role requires a strategic mindset, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 The HR professional will work closely with leadership, hiring managers, and cross\-functional teams to understand business hiring needs and build effective recruitment strategies. The role also involves strengthening employer branding, improving hiring processes, and ensuring the organization consistently hires high\-quality talent aligned with its long\-term goals.
   

  

**Requirements**

* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, including role scoping, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.
* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand workforce planning needs and develop effective hiring strategies.
* Source candidates through multiple channels including job portals, professional networks, referrals, social platforms, and direct outreach.

* Conduct candidate screening, competency\-based interviews, and evaluation to ensure quality hiring decisions.

* Negotiate compensation packages and manage offer rollouts while ensuring alignment with company policies.
* Drive recruitment metrics and analytics such as time\-to\-hire, quality of hire, and sourcing effectiveness to continuously improve hiring processes.
* Enhance employer branding by representing the organization across professional platforms and recruitment initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with internal HR policies and hiring standards throughout the recruitment process.

**Required Skills And Competencies**
* Strong expertise in recruitment and talent acquisition strategies.
* Proven experience managing high\-volume and specialized hiring across multiple roles and seniority levels.
* Excellent candidate sourcing skills using job portals, LinkedIn, professional communities, and referral networks.
* Strong interviewing and candidate assessment capabilities.
* Ability to build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior leadership.
* Data\-driven approach with experience using recruitment metrics and reporting tools.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA or equivalent HR qualification is preferred.
* 6\-21 years of relevant HR experience with a strong emphasis on recruitment

 In this role, you will serve as a strategic HR leader for a globally distributed, remote\-first business unit, ensuring that people processes align with business goals and drive team performance. You will work closely with managers to optimize staffing, engagement, and retention, while implementing HR initiatives that enhance employee satisfaction and productivity. Your influence will extend across hiring, onboarding, performance management, and employee development, fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and collaboration. Operating in a fast\-paced, international environment, you will balance strategic planning with hands\-on HR operations, supporting teams across multiple countries. You will have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on workforce performance and organizational success.

* Ensure the effectiveness and productivity of employees within the business unit, aligning personnel efforts with strategic goals and financial targets.
* Manage staffing levels, ensuring the right people are in the right roles and that probationary and performance standards are met.

* Goal\-oriented, data\-driven, and persistent, with the ability to achieve outcomes under pressure and through ambiguity.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in both English and Russian.
* Ability to work effectively in multicultural and distributed teams, balancing strategic planning with operational execution.

title: Senior Manager, People Platforms & Global Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
 Atlan is building the missing context layer for data and AI, helping enterprises close the AI value chasm and finally move AI pilots into production. Today, 95% of AI pilots fail because AI systems don’t understand the context behind data: what it means, how it’s governed, and how it should be used.
   

  

 Atlan unifies this context by connecting to every part of the data and AI stack, enabling teams to
 **build, collaborate on, and activate shared context** 
 across data, business, and AI workflows, including for AI agents.
   

  

 Trusted by global enterprises like
 **Mastercard, Workday, General Motors, Unilever, Ralph Lauren, FOX, Nasdaq, and Medtronic** 
 , we’re backed by world\-class investors including
 **GIC, Insight Partners, Meritech, Peak XV, and Salesforce Ventures**
**The Opportunity**
 We’re hiring a Senior Manager, People Platforms \& Global Operations to build the operating system behind the Atlanian experience. As a remote\-first, multi\-country company, we want our People Ops to feel as thoughtful, fast, and well\-designed as the products we ship.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of People Ops, systems, and AI. You’ll own the platforms, workflows, and data that power everything from onboarding to mobility to compliance, bringing a systems\-first, AI\-native mindset to how we scale. You’ll be hands\-on in the tools and lead a small team, shaping an operating model that’s clear, measurable, and built to last.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Own the People OS**
* Be the product owner for our core People systems (HRIS, helpdesk, workflow/automation tools, integrations).
* Design joiner / mover / leaver and other lifecycle flows so they’re documented, measurable (SLAs, volumes, error rates), and easy to delegate.
* Partner with IT and Engineering to maintain clean data, strong integrations, and reliable audit trails.


**Make AI and automation real**
* Redesign high\-volume, repeatable workflows for automation and AI support (triage, routing, drafting, checks).
* Use AI to classify requests, draft communications and policy summaries, and spot patterns in People data.
* Set clear guardrails: define what runs end\-to\-end and where humans review.


**Lead global lifecycle and compliance ops**
* Own onboarding and offboarding across entities and EORs.
* Oversee manager, job, and location changes, plus global mobility in partnership with Legal and Finance.
* Turn People policies and compliance requirements (background checks, eligibility, leave rules) into clear system workflows and playbooks. Manage the People\-Ops side of EOR relationships and maintain a lightweight services catalog so Atlanians know what to expect.


**Lead and partner well**
* Manage People Ops ICs (starting with a coordinator).
* Partner closely with Talent, Finance, Legal, IT, and Security to keep everything aligned and on track.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 10\+ years in People Ops, HR Ops, People Platforms, or Global HR Ops in a high\-growth, multi\-country company.
* Primary owner of at least one HRIS or major People system implementation or re\-architecture. Led a helpdesk, service\-management, or workflow\-automation rollout that materially changed how a team worked.
* Hands\-on exposure to employment and benefits compliance operations, with experience partnering with Legal.
* Comfort operating across time zones and employment models (entities, EORs, contractors).


**Why Atlan?**
 Joining Atlan Means Being Part Of a Global Movement To Help Data Teams Do Their Life’s Best Work. Here’s What You Can Expect
   

  

* Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity, so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
* Health \& Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to pet‑care perks and flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.
* Flexible Time Off \& Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.
* Accelerated Growth \& Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting\-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.
* AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI\-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add\-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.
* Global, Remote\-First, High\-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15\+ countries, in a trust\-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.


***Equal Opportunity Employer***
*Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

description:

 The HR Operations Employee Services Associate is responsible for providing best\-in\-class employee experience across the Employee Lifecycle (hire to retire) . As a key member of our People Experience \& Operations team, the role holder will play a pivotal role in driving on ground employee processes ( with clear KPIs and service levels) .Role is pivotal in supporting India BU agenda of digitization and seamless employee experience through identified priorities for the People Experience \& Operations vertical.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Talent Acquisition
* Frontline hiring: Drive frontline hiring – collaborate with employment exchange, screening, interview scheduling, background checks, and coordinating pre\-employment testing.
* Coordinate onboarding for plant employees\- adherence to H2O for onboarding followed by completion of Day 1 and Functional Onboarding modules on my learning.
* Contractual Hiring: Collaborate with concerned department on contractual worker requirement based on business requirement.
* Employee Processes \& Admin
* Serve as a first\-point contact for employee inquiries regarding policies, benefits, payroll, schedules, procedures and all processes pertaining to employee lifecycle.
* Drive learning admin for identified employee groups, facilitation of training, tracking, follow up and closure
* Support employee engagement programs such as Dil Se, Plant days, and other engagement interventions (OHS) followed by communications and surveys.
* Digitization
* Drive the overall BU digitization agenda – specifically for plant like T\&A for PCI and NPCI workforce, Schoox and other myServices related workflow processes
* Identify areas of opportunities that can be streamlined and elevated using digital tools.
* Compliance \& Safety Support
* Ensure compliance with central, state, and local employment regulations, including AIB audit as defined in the statutory laws of the land.
* Maintain confidential employee files, ensuring documentation compliance for audits.
* Collaborate with Safety and Operations teams to track training, certifications, and required plant clearances.
* Collaborate with Welfare Officer to drive on ground operational activities
* CoE led interventions
* Coordinate training sessions, track completion, and maintain required training records as cascaded by center of excellence for TM , TR and PE\&O
* Support performance\-review cycles by organizing timelines, forms, and reminders\- through identified interventions like communication, in\-house sessions etc. Support PMP on ground activation for all phases (objective setting, mid year and year end) covering all frontline employees
* Support on Core People Process roll out. This includes but is not limited to on ground Survey administration via roadshows for frontline employees for Org Health and MPW
* Provide Learning logistics support (venue organization, coordination with vendors/trainers, invoicing, learning attendance and feedback administration)
* Organise and administer CoC training for frontline employees, new hires and third party employees
* Provide logistics support for HR Events (Rewards and Recognition, Function Annual events, HR Townhalls). Support creation of event content such as communications, presentations, invites etc.
* Plant Operations Support /HR Ops and Service delivery
* Provide general administrative support to Plant leadership and HR lead for operational activities(reports, presentations, data entry).
* Participate in continuous improvement efforts to optimize HR and plant processes.
* Work as an integral part in the BU HR Ops team projects deliverables
* Act as a focal point for the accounts HR operations deliverables
* Manage all the requested reporting repository for the accounts deliverables
* Identify opportunities for process enhancement and digitization
* Accountable for handling all accounts queries through the agreed SLAs and identified channels


**Qualifications**
 MBA in Human Resources

description:

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

The group’s Follow the Sun Model ensures that the firm’s operations are consistent and efficient across all investment products, client channels and regions, helping to deliver a superior client experience and drive scalability. Aladdin Platform Eng\- HS – Network Management is driven by a global network of Operating Centers of Excellence, which centralizes knowledge and equips support teams with the data and timely information needed to innovate and deliver on behalf of internal partners and clients.
   

  

 Network Operations is responsible for managing the global network and security infrastructure. The team performs multiple operational tasks, projects and engineering aspects in routing, load balancing, monitoring and optimizing the network. Network Operations Center (NOC) is the foundation of the Global Network Operations team which provides active monitoring and remediation of incidents, alerts and any infrastructure stability issues. The team is also responsible for automation to quickly identify and resolve issues, Adapt AI‑enabled workflows and automation that reduce manual effort, accelerate triage, and support predictive operations.
   

  

**As a Network Operations Engineer, You Will**
* Provide 1st/2nd line technical support \& incident management, monitoring for circuits and hardware. Report and track carrier issues, hardware RMA’s etc.
* Manage operational network maintenance activities and implement changes
* Provide monitoring \& fault management and remediation of alerts. Tuning \& optimization of monitoring systems
* Respond within standard published MTTA and MTTR
* Assist with root cause analysis of incidents
* Assist with periodic network reviews and analysis
* Assist in Alert noise reduction by introducing Automation
* Help with establishment of operational procedures \& support documentation

**What You'll Need**
* 3\+ years’ experience in IT infrastructure operations/support role

* Experience with various Cisco equipment (routers, switches)
* Experience with Checkpoint, Cisco firewalls, load balancers and WAN accelerators is desirable
* Experience in scripting and programming skills (Python, Ansible, Terraform) is desirable

**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. title: Network Engineer
description:
**DESCRIPTION:** 




 The Network Engineer’s role is to ensure the stability and integrity of in\-house voice, data, video, and wireless network services. This is achieved by planning, designing, and developing local area networks (LANs) and wide area networks (WANs) across the organization. In addition, the Network Engineer will participate with the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimization of all network hardware, software, and communication links. This individual will also analyze and resolve network hardware and software problems in a timely and accurate fashion, and provide end user training.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES:** 




***Strategy \& Planning***




 • Collaborate with department heads to assess near\- and long\-term network capacity needs.
 



 • Create and maintain documentation as it relates to network configuration, network mapping, processes, and service records.
 



 • Develop, implement and maintain policies, procedures, and associated training plans for network administration, usage, and disaster recovery.
 



***Acquisition \& Deployment***




 • Design and deploy LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including routers, hubs, switches, firewalls, UPSs, and other hardware.
 



 • Conduct research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the networking industry.
 



 • Oversee new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades.
 



 • Interact and negotiate with vendors, outsourcers, and contractors to secure network products and services.
 



***Operational Management***





 • Configure networks to ensure their smooth and reliable operation for fulfilling objectives and processes.
 



 • Monitor network performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed.
 



 • Ensure network connectivity of all servers, workstations, telephony equipment, fax machines, and other network appliances.
 



 • Practice network asset management, including maintenance of network component inventory and related documentation and technical specifications information.
 



 • Monitor and test network performance and provide network performance statistics and reports.
 



 • Participate in managing all network security solutions.
 



  





**POSITION REQUIREMENT (Knowledge \& Experience):** 




 • Proven experience and success with LAN, WAN, WLAN, and WWAN design and implementation.
 



 • Proven experience with Cisco ASA and Firepower firewalls, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco Nexus and Catalyst switches, Juniper switches, Cisco AIR and Catalyst Wifi.
 



 • Proven experience with network capacity planning, network security principles, and general network management best practices.
 



 • Proven experience with VOIP phone systems.
 



 • Excellent hardware troubleshooting experience.
 



 • Competence with testing tools and procedures for voice and data circuits.
 



 • Good understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.
 



 • Knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and laws.
 



 • Strong interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
 



 • Able to conduct research into networking issues and products as required.
 



 • Ability to present ideas in user\-friendly language.
 



 • Highly self motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.
 



 • Proven analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
 



 • Able to effectively prioritize tasks in a high\-pressure environment.
 



 • Strong customer service orientation.
 



 • Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.
 



  





**REQUIRED EDUCATION/ CERTIFICATION:** 




 • The Network Engineer will have a bachelor’s degree or, an associate’s degree with 4 years of related experience, or 6 years related experience

description:

* Communicates and reports on the effectiveness of the firm’s governance, risk management and controls that mitigate current and evolving risk

* Should be a self\-starter with excellent written and verbal communications skills, able to handle several projects simultaneously with minimum supervision, must be well\-organized, and able to prioritize work to meet established deadlines.

* Must embrace diverse people, thinking, and styles.
* Guide and mentor “Engineers” within the WISG team to deliver on key business objectives.

* Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology \& trends.
* Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions.

* Experience in MS Office products, Epic Editor, CORENA Studio, MS Office products and Adobe Professional highly preferred.
* Being an innovative thinker with a positive outlook, a vision for software improvements, and continual drive toward process improvements.

 climbing from its No. 8 spot in 2023 to No. 2 in the travel category. The airline was recognized for its Wi\-Fi revolution that is working to ensure the future of travel is connected.

**Description**
 Within the Selection Monitoring team, a Business analyst is expected to own analytics on large volumes of data, synthesize the analysis into business insights, communicate the findings to stakeholders and and deliver business value. Business analyst will be expected to be skilled in understanding customer needs, converting them to analysis requirements, having working knowledge of data availability in various sources, building customer confidence through effective communication and derive recommendations. Business analyst would also be responsible for the project plan, cost and efficiency analytics platform resources, scaling of data processes and reports, and project timeline and deliverables.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Solve ambiguous problems with less well\-defined inputs and outputs; drive to the heart of the problem and identify root causes
* Identify, develop and execute data analysis to uncover areas of business opportunities
* Learn and understand the broad range of Amazon’s data resources and develop knowledge of how, when and which data sources to use
* Deep dive into massive data sets to answer key business questions using SQL, MS Excel and other data manipulation languages
* Build new reports/dashboards to enable emerging business use cases
* Partner with Data Engineering team to deploy new data technology
* Present written recommendations and insights to key stakeholders that will help shape effective selection expansion strategies worldwide
* Manage and execute entire projects or components of large projects from start to finish including project management, data gathering and manipulation, modeling and problem solving


**About The Team**
 Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team started operations in March 2009 and has grown steadily in scope ever since. Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems group at Amazon Chennai Center focuses on making direct impact on Selection for Amazon’s Retail \& 3rd party marketplace business across markets worldwide. The Selection Monitoring team within this group owns end to end processes for discovering, prioritizing and adding new selection available to customers across different markets worldwide. This drives one of Amazon’s core focus areas: providing the widest selection to customers. We operate in a fast paced, rapidly growing environment offering new challenges and opportunities for making impactful changes in the Amazon ecosystem.

* 4\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 4\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, engineering , analytics, mathematics, statistics or a related technical or quantitative field
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Experience with Excel

**Job Description**
 Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Servicing Associate II and be at the forefront of enhancing our operational services in fund accounting and administration. This role offers a unique opportunity for career growth and skill development, as you collaborate with a dynamic team and contribute to impactful solutions. Experience the benefits of being part of a leading financial institution that values innovation and continuous improvement.
   

  

 As a Fund Servicing Manager ll within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our fund servicing operations. Leveraging your broad knowledge of fund accounting and administration, you will provide advice and support to ensure progress within established procedures and policies. Your work will have a significant impact on our department, requiring you to apply your advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills to develop solutions for varied and complex issues. Your advanced emotional intelligence will be key in building trusting relationships and influencing better outcomes for our team and clients. Your role will also involve planning and directing the day\-to\-day work of our staff, ensuring the continuous improvement of our operating platform.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Oversee the maintenance of accurate accounting and securities records for each fund administered, ensuring adherence to all prescribed controls for fund accounting processes.
* Investigate and resolve issues where accounting or securities transactions breach the validation tolerances of the JP Morgan system, applying advanced problem\-solving skills.
* Influence and negotiate with the ability to develop and maintain collaborative relationships both internally and with external clients to drive results.
* Implement operational procedures to complete tasks accurately and timely.
* Provide training to new hires, establishing performance objectives and promoting a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
* Partner with various Operations Teams, Technology, Product, Sales, Program Management.
* Identify and address vulnerabilities in our fund servicing processes, leveraging your proficiency in continuous improvement to enhance efficiency and resilience.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Demonstrated expertise in fund accounting and administration, with at least three years of experience focusing on maintaining accurate securities records, evidenced by successful management of related tasks and responsibilities.
* Demonstrated proficiency in identifying and resolving issues related to accounting or securities transactions, ensuring compliance with validation tolerances.
* Proven ability to implement operational procedures and controls, with a focus on enhancing cybersecurity and anti\-fraud measures.
* Experience in training and managing a team, with a focus on establishing performance objectives and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
* Advanced emotional intelligence skills, with a proven track record of building trusting relationships and influencing better outcomes for teams and clients.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience working across multiple business areas and/or functions to deliver results.
* Financial Reporting, Fund Administration, Accounting and/or Custody experience of 5 years preferred.


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**

**Job Overview:**
 As a Web Developer, you will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of Drupal\-based websites and tools. You will be part of a global marketing team and will be working with agency and internal stakeholders to implement customized solutions as and when needed.

**Who This Role Is Built For**

This is not a generic customer support job. This role is for someone who genuinely loves chess — or wants to build a real remote career in a mission\-driven global organization — and for whom stability, purpose, and professional growth matter more than chasing the next offer.

If you are a chess enthusiast, a homemaker returning to professional life, or a fresher from a Tier\-2/Tier\-3 city looking for a credible long\-term remote career — we built this role for you.

**About Chess Gaja**

Chess Gaja is a global online chess academy founded by Grandmaster Priyadharshan Kannappan, serving students across 40\+ countries. We combine world\-class chess coaching with structured operations and automation — and we want people who want to grow with us for the long term.

**What You Will Do**

* Manage parent and student communication via WhatsApp Business and email across global time zones
* Send payment reminders, class updates, and performance reports on a strict weekly schedule
* Coordinate feedback between 40\+ coaches and parents with accuracy and empathy
* Maintain 100% accurate records in Zoho CRM — if it isn't logged, it didn't happen
* Be the first point of contact that makes every Chess Gaja family feel supported and seen

**You Will Thrive Here If**

* You have a basic love for chess (1000\+ rating on Chess.com or Lichess is a plus — not mandatory)
* You write professional, polite English fluently — grammar matters here
* You are comfortable using tools like ChatGPT, Sheets, and Zoho without needing hand\-holding
* You want a long\-term remote career, not a 3\-month stepping stone
* You take pride in process, follow\-up discipline, and doing small things with consistency
* You have a reliable laptop, mobile, and 50\+ Mbps internet connection at home

**What We Offer**

* ₹17,000 – ₹19,000 monthly take\-home (Includes a yearly retention bonus as part of the compensation)
* 100% permanent remote — no commute required
* Direct mentorship exposure to a Grandmaster and global operations
* Hands\-on mastery of Zoho One — one of the most in\-demand business automation suites
* A stable, structured team that respects your time and contributions

*(Other shifts such as 5:00 AM – 2:00 PM or 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM may be assigned after probation)*

Please apply through Indeed. **Note:** You will be required to answer 3\-4 screening questions as part of your application. Candidates who skip these or provide incomplete answers will be automatically disqualified.
