title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Senior Product Analyst \- AI \& Automation


**Location:** Hyderabad
  

**Pattern of Work:** Hybrid
  

**Reporting to:** Senior Manager – AI \& Automation Products


**Note:** This role requires flexibility to collaborate across geographies and time zones, working with stakeholders in the UK and other global locations.


**About the Role**

We are seeking an proactive technical Product Analyst to join our growing AI \& Automation team within Enterprise Technology. You will play a pivotal role in scaling AI adoption across the organisation by serving as the critical bridge between internal business stakeholders and our Enterprise Tech Delivery, Architecture and Engineering teams.
  

You will own the Technical Discovery process—taking high\-level business problems from Flutter brands and functions such as Finance, Legal, Procurement, Tech and HR, and translating them into robust, platform\-centric technical specifications. You will focus on how our AI platforms (APIs, model orchestration, and AI \& Automation frameworks) can be leveraged to create scalable, secure, and high\-impact and high\-value internal solutions that can be shared and utilised across all Flutter brands and global divisions.


**What You'll Do**

  

**Technical Product Discovery \& Design**

* **PRD Ownership:** Lead the creation of comprehensive **Product Requirement Documents (PRDs)** that translate business objectives into clear technical specifications for the engineering teams.
* **Proactive Opportunity Mapping:** Use your initiative to identify friction points within internal functions and propose AI solutions that address underlying technical challenges.
* **Scalable Capability Building:** Ensure stakeholder requests are designed as modular platform capabilities that can be **leveraged across the entire global organisation** , avoiding isolated or one\-off solutions.

**Communication \& Strategic Reporting**

* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Maintain consistent, proactive communication with business leads and management, ensuring they understand the technical roadmap, progress, and how AI solutions solve their specific challenges.
* **Product Value Reporting:** Create and deliver updates to management on project outcomes, focusing on benefits realisation, productivity gains, and the strategic impact of platform features.
* **Show \& Tell Sessions:** Lead product demos and showcase sessions for internal stakeholders to drive awareness, gather feedback, and encourage adoption of AI capabilities.

**Technical Alignment \& Delivery Collaboration**

* **Backlog Refinement:** Own the "Definition of Ready." You ensure user stories are technically robust and logically sound, allowing the engineering team to focus on development without facing requirement gaps.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure the technical solution aligns with their original intent, providing clarity on product value and functional trade\-offs.
* **Dependency Identification:** Identify and document technical dependencies between the AI platform and existing internal systems to ensure smooth integration and prevent development delays.

**Governance, Quality \& Responsible AI**

* **Responsible AI Guardrails:** Incorporate ethics, security, and privacy requirements directly into the technical product specifications by design.
* **Validation \& UAT:** Define technical acceptance criteria and oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure the platform output is fit for purpose and achieves the intended productivity gains.

**Continuous Improvement**

* **Stay informed** on AI trends, platform engineering best practices, and agentic AI capabilities
* **Contribute** to the evolution of our operating model, engagement processes, and value frameworks.

**About You**

**Essential:**

* **Self\-Driven Approach:** You are high\-agency and proactive. You don't wait for instruction; you navigate the organisation to gather information and define the best path forward.
* **Technical Product Background:** 4\-6 years of experience delivering platform or data\-centric products You excel at translating ambiguous customer asks into tangible delivery tokens that can be handed off to engineering teams. You have shipped products to production and can demonstrate working knowledge of AI tools and platforms.
* **Traditional Product Mindset \- with AI Lens:** You bring proven product management fundamentals and apply them through the lens of AI capabilities and constraints. You will leverage AI to maximise your productivity in your execution of the role.
* **Tech Savvy:** You are comfortable with technical concepts, tools, and emerging technologies, enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams. You have working knowledge of Gen AI, large language models, and integration frameworks (deep technical expertise not required).
* **Contemporary Knowledge:** You stay current with industry trends, AI developments, and modern product practices.
* **Entrepreneurial Mindset:** You thrive in rapidly evolving environments where agility, ownership, and adaptability are essential. You're comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the pace of change in the AI landscape. Ideally, you have experience from a startup environment, particularly one that has launched AI products in the last 1\-2 years.
* **Systems Thinking:** Ability to understand how AI interacts with enterprise architecture. You are comfortable discussing data flows and technical constraints with Architects and Engineers. You can map value frameworks into tickets, ensuring clarity for delivery teams.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** You are skilled at building and maintaining partnership networks with internal stakeholders, across different geographies and time zones, acting as the bridge between customer needs and product delivery. You excel in a partnering model, bringing fluidity to the process of passing partner asks to Engineering and other teams.
* **Global Perspective: A** passion for building "once for many," ensuring that features built for one part of the business provide value across the entire global organisation.
* **Collaborative Mindset:** Proven ability to work alongside Architecture, Engineering and Delivery teams to ensure high\-quality product releases. You bring fluidity to the process of passing partner asks to Engineering and other teams.
* **Communication:** Outstanding skills in translating complex technical concepts for diverse internal audiences.
* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Strong time management and organizational skills to manage product development from discovery through delivery and adoption.
* **Value Framework Orientation:** Ability to map business value frameworks into actionable delivery tickets and measure outcomes against strategic objectives.

**What Would Set You Apart:**

* Experience with AI, automation, or platform engineering products (e.g., NLP, Gen AI, or agentic workflows).
* Familiarity with AI platforms, orchestration tools, or enterprise AI adoption such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Responsible AI, governance frameworks, or AI ethics.
* Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Confluence, or product analytics platforms.

**About the AI \& Automation Team**

The AI \& Automation team sits within Enterprise Technology and is responsible for building, deploying, and operating AI platforms and capabilities for Flutter. Our mission is to create the platforms, tools, and secure environments that enable AI adoption—embedding responsible AI safeguards into every layer.
  

We're building shared AI platforms that ensure innovation happens once and is delivered everywhere—combining immediate workforce impact with long\-term, scalable value.


We're working to be an inclusive employer, and we encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking and working to apply. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don't have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role.

title: HR Generalist
description:
As our HR Generalist, you will be the backbone of our HR \& Talent Acquisition operations and the support to the Head of HR. In this role, you will take ownership of our operational framework, ensuring that every process, from drafting contracts to managing precise monthly payroll, is executed timely and accurately. By managing BambooHR and taking ownership of our recruitment workflows, you ensure that our administrative processes are consistently accurate and our data remains reliable for all daily operations.

  

This role is primarily office\-based to support collaboration, teamwork, and visibility across the organisation. The HR Generalist is expected to work from the office 4 days per week, with 1 day per week working from home.

 **Key Responsibilities**


**Talent Acquisition Execution**


* Manage the full\-cycle recruitment process for all open roles, from initial sourcing on job boards, to conducting screenings and coordinating hiring manager interviews.
* Draft and maintain accurate job descriptions and ensure all vacancies are posted on relevant industry boards and the JOI Careers page.
* Manage the candidate pipeline within BambooHR, ensuring timely feedback and a professional candidate experience.
* Conduct pre\-employment due diligence, including reference checks and right\-to\-work verifications.

  


**HR Operations \& Compliance**


* Serve as the administrator for BambooHR, ensuring all employee data, digital files, and lifecycle changes (promotions, salary adjustments) are 100% accurate.
* Manage all local statutory requirements, including the timely filing of engagement and termination forms.
* Draft employment contracts, addenda, and termination letters in strict accordance with local legislation and GDPR.
* Oversee the offboarding process, ensuring the recovery of company assets and completion of statutory documentation.

  


**Payroll Preparation \& Benefits Administration**


* Prepare the monthly pay\-run by collecting data on leave, bonuses, salary changes, etc., liaising directly with the external payroll providers and Finance team.
* Administer all employee benefits, including, but not limited to, monetary allowances and occupational pension scheme.
* Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding payroll queries, policy clarifications, and leave entitlements.

  


**Benefits**


* €1,000 Annual Wellness Allowance.
* Relocation package available for those joining us from abroad.
* Wellness \& Work\-Life Balance
* Employee Assistance Program \- €250 per annum
* Birthday Leave – enjoy an extra day off to celebrate your special day
* Anniversary Leave – enjoy an extra day for every year at Joi Gaming.
* Friday Drinks \& Lunch – a weekly get\-together to connect with your team
* Hybrid work – 1 day from home per week after your 6\-month probation
* Remote work abroad – work from anywhere for up to 1 month per year
* Free parking for cars and motorbikes

Our commitment to you:


* **Our aspiration:** A culture where every person feels confident navigating their unique path and inspired to grow every step of the way.
* **Our support**: Meeting you where you are, empowering your growth with clarity, support, and purpose.
* **Our promise**: Your growth is yours to lead, but never a journey you take alone.
 **Job Summary:**



The Systems Specialist will be responsible for owning and managing multiple internal systems and tools used across the organization. This role will ensure systems are properly maintained, audited, updated, and supported throughout the employee lifecycle, including onboarding and offboarding. The individual will also support system implementations, scheduling processes, and act as primary support for key productivity and collaboration platforms.


**Responsibilities:**


***Systems Ownership \& Administration:***


* Own and manage various internal systems and applications, ensuring accuracy, security, and reliability.
* Perform regular system audits, updates, and access reviews.
* Maintain system documentation, processes, and controls.


***Onboarding \& Offboarding:***


* Support employee onboarding by provisioning system access, tools, and permissions.
* Manage offboarding processes, ensuring timely deactivation of access and compliance with security policies.
* Coordinate closely with HR, IT, and People Operations teams.


***System Implementations \& Improvements:***


* Support the implementation of new systems and tools, including testing, configuration, and rollout.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and vendors to ensure successful adoption.
* Identify opportunities for system improvements and process automation.


***Scheduling \& Calendar Management:***


* Support scheduling needs and manage company\-wide calendars.
* Provide administrative support for Outlook calendars and scheduling tools.
* Assist with meeting coordination across teams and time zones.


***Application \& Tool Support:***



Act as primary support for the following tools (or similar platforms):


* UKG Ready
* WorkRamp
* Gong
* Outlook
* Hello (or HelloSign / Hello\-related tools, if applicable)
* Zoom
* Snapbar


**Responsibilities include:**


* User support and troubleshooting
* Access management
* Basic configuration and setup
* Vendor coordination as needed


**Compliance \& Auditing:**


* Support internal and external audits related to systems and access controls.
* Ensure systems are compliant with company policies and data protection standards.

  


**Required Qualifications:**


* 2\+ years of experience in systems administration, HR systems, IT operations, or a related role.
* Hands\-on experience supporting multiple SaaS tools and internal systems.
* Strong understanding of user access management, onboarding, and offboarding processes.
* Experience with scheduling tools, calendars, and collaboration platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting HRIS, LMS, CRM, or enablement tools.
* Familiarity with audit processes and access controls.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced or scaling organization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Fixed CTC: 12,00,000 \- 13,00,000 INR

description:

For more information, visit www.johnsoncontrols.com or follow us @johnsoncontrols on Twitter.  

  

**What you will do:**  

We are looking for a proactive and collaborative **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to drive full‑cycle hiring . In this role, you’ll partner closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and HR stakeholders to attract top talent, strengthen our employer brand, and create an exceptional candidate experience.

 **How you will do it:**

### **1\. End\-to\-End Recruitment**

* Manage full‑cycle recruiting across functions (sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management).
* Understand hiring needs, create job descriptions, and recommend sourcing strategies tailored to each role.
* Conduct competency‑based interviews and coordinate interview panels.

### **2\. Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline Development**

* Build and maintain active talent pipelines using job boards, professional networks, referrals, and social recruiting.
* Leverage platforms like Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and industry groups to identify high\-quality talent.
* Engage and nurture passive candidates for future requirements.

### **3\. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a consultative partner to business leaders on market insights, hiring timelines, and talent availability.
* Provide regular updates, dashboards, and status reports to stakeholders.
* Manage alignment meetings, debrief discussions, and offer approvals.

### **4\. Candidate Experience \& Employer Branding**

* Deliver a seamless and positive experience from application to onboarding.
* Represent the organization professionally at all candidate touchpoints.
* Support employer branding initiatives for local talent markets.

### **5\. Offer Management \& Compliance**

* Drive salary negotiations, offer creation, and pre‑joining engagement.
* Ensure compliance with company hiring guidelines and India employment regulations.
* Work closely with HR Ops, background verification teams, and onboarding partners.

### **6\. Recruitment Data \& Process Excellence**

* Maintain accurate data in ATS systems.
* Track metrics such as TAT, source mix, pipeline ratios, and candidate conversion.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, tools, and overall efficiency.
* Compile, analyze data and metrics to support business decisions and plans as necessary.
* Development of Talent Pipeline for Diversity and Inclusion (D\&I) Initiatives and future needs.
* Act as a brand ambassador leveraging a multi\-channel strategy, in partnership with Talent Brand \& Communications to promote our Employer Value Program (EVP) in the target market.

  

  

**What we look for:**

* 5\+ years of full\-cycle recruiting experience in preferably into commercial hiring
* Strong experience in sourcing related activities to help drive talent into the organization
* Demonstrated ability to build recruiting strategy, employer branding, candidate management, talent sourcing with emphasis on diversity and inclusion.
* Strong skills in talent research and sourcing, social media recruiting and other techniques to identify and engage with talent.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
* Excellent communication skills – written and verbal.
* Proven experience with LinkedIn sourcing, both passive and active

HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and exits across the region.

HR Analytics, Dashboards \& Reporting* Own and track key HR metrics such as attrition, attendance, manpower analytics, performance cycle progress, etc.

Payroll \& Benefits Administration* Coordinate regional payroll inputs and ensure payroll accuracy in collaboration with payroll vendors/finance.

Regional HR Support \& Business Partnering* Act as the primary HR point of contact for regional business leaders and employees.
* Support manpower planning, attrition analysis, and workforce metrics.
* Provide HR operational insights and reports to leadership.


Vendor \& Stakeholder Management* Manage HR vendors (payroll, background verification, staffing, compliance consultants).
* Coordinate with corporate HR, finance, legal, and admin teams.


Process Improvement \& Digitization* Drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of HR processes.
* Support HR system upgrades and new initiatives.


Knowledge, Experience and Skills:* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent
* 8–12 years of experience in HR Operations, preferably in a multi\-location or regional role
* Experience in handling large employee bases
* Hands\-on experience with HR operations and payroll management
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* High attention to detail and process orientation
* Problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities
* Proficiency in MS Excel


What do we offer* An opportunity that provides open culture and challenges to satisfy intellectual needs
* Smart working: hybrid remote/office working environment

* Ability to work with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced environment.

title: System Engineer
description:
We are looking for System Engineer (L1\) is the first line of support responsible for ensuring business continuity through effective incident and request management. This role focuses on monitoring systems, capturing user\-reported issues, performing first\-level triage, resolving predefined technical problems using documented SOPs, and escalating complex issues to higher support levels.


The role operates in a shift\-based support model and plays a critical role in maintaining service availability, SLA adherence, and high\-quality user communication.

 **Key Responsibilities** **Incident \& Request Management**

* Log, categorize, prioritize, and track incidents and service requests in the ticketing system.
* Perform initial triage using predefined runbooks and SOPs.
* Resolve known and repetitive issues within defined authority.
* Escalate unresolved or complex incidents to L2 support with proper documentation.

**Monitoring \& First\-Level Troubleshooting**

* Monitor dashboards and alerts for infrastructure and application health.
* Identify and respond to alerts related to disk utilization, memory pressure, CPU usage, and service availability.
* Execute basic corrective actions such as service restarts and health validations.

**Ticket Lifecycle \& SLA Management**

* Create tickets for all reported incidents and ensure SLA adherence with timely action closure.
* Maintain detailed RCA documentation for all P1/P2 incidents.
* Document service\-level changes, alert migrations, and configuration updates.

**User Communication**

* Provide timely and professional updates to reporters
* Respond to emails within the same business day.
* Communicate clearly during incidents and service disruptions.

**Knowledge Base \& Documentation**

* Refer to the knowledge base before escalation.
* Contribute to documentation for recurring incidents.
* Follow incident checklists and operational guidelines.

**Shift \& Handover Management**

* Perform structured shift handovers.
* Highlight open incidents, risks, and pending actions.
* Ensure continuity across shifts.

**Technical Expertise**

**Operating Systems \& Basics**

* Linux fundamentals (process monitoring, disk, memory, logs, service management)

**Monitoring \& Tooling**

* Exposure to monitoring and alerting too
* Basic log interpretation and alert validation

**Cloud Awareness**

* Basic understanding of AWS services (EC2 health, storage, instance status)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate degree (Science / Computer Applications / IT preferred)
* 0\-2 year experience in system or production support (freshers with strong fundamentals may apply)
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

description:
**Job Title: Trainee – Field Service Engineer (IT Hardware Infrastructure)**

**Location:** Trivandrum, Kerala  
**Department:** Service \& Support / IT Operations  
**Reporting To:** Service Manager / Regional Support Lead  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time / Internship / Contract (as applicable)

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a **Trainee – Field Service Engineer** to join our technical support team and assist with **on\-site installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting** of IT hardware infrastructure. This role is ideal for candidates with a strong interest in IT hardware, field service operations, and hands\-on technical support.

You will gain practical experience by supporting client infrastructure, learning from experienced engineers, and growing into an independent support role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in the **installation, configuration, and maintenance** of IT hardware such as desktops, laptops, printers, servers, routers, switches, and UPS systems.
* Support troubleshooting of hardware faults at client sites under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Perform **basic diagnostics and preventive maintenance** to ensure system uptime and reliability.
* Maintain records of service calls, equipment history, and customer interactions.
* Ensure proper handling and documentation of service tools, spare parts, and assets.
* Adhere to defined **SOPs, service protocols, and safety standards** while on\-site.
* Provide clear updates to clients regarding service progress, timelines, and next steps.
* Assist with hardware upgrades, imaging, and basic network connectivity checks.
* Work with the service coordinator and technical team to plan site visits and service schedules.
* Participate in training sessions to build knowledge and stay updated with evolving technologies.

**Requirements:**

* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware components and peripherals.
* Willingness to travel to client locations as part of the job.
* Good communication and customer\-handling skills.
* Ability to follow instructions and work independently on assigned tasks.
* Strong interest in IT hardware, systems, and field\-based work.
* Possession of a valid driving license is preferred (if field mobility is expected).

**Preferred Skills:**

* Familiarity with Windows OS installation, basic networking, BIOS setup, and driver updates.
* Exposure to ticketing systems or helpdesk tools is a plus.
* Certifications like A\+, N\+, or any basic hardware training will be an advantage.

**Job Title**: .NET Developer

**Organization:** National Informatics Centre (NIC)  
**Location:** Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir, India  
**Department:** e\-Governance / Software Development  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time / Contract

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled **.NET Developer** to join the development team at NIC Jammu. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining web applications and e\-Governance solutions using Microsoft .NET technologies. The role requires collaboration with cross\-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure digital services for government stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance **web applications using .NET technologies**.
* Design and implement **ASP.NET / .NET Core based applications**.
* Work on **front\-end integration using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like Angular or React**.
* Develop and manage **RESTful APIs and Web Services**.
* Perform **database design, development, and optimization using SQL Server**.
* Ensure **application security, performance, and scalability**.
* Participate in **code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting**.
* Collaborate with project managers, system analysts, and stakeholders for requirement analysis.
* Maintain **technical documentation and deployment procedures**.
* Support **existing government applications and portals** developed by NIC.

**Required SkillsTechnical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **C\# and .NET Framework / .NET Core**
* Experience with **ASP.NET MVC / Web API**
* Proficiency in **Microsoft SQL Server**
* Experience with **Entity Framework / LINQ**
* Knowledge of **HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript**
* Familiarity with **Git or version control systems**
* Experience with **REST APIs and microservices architecture**

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **Angular / React**
* Knowledge of **Azure or cloud deployment**
* Understanding of **government e\-Governance platforms**
* Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines**

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree** in Computer Science, IT, or related field (B.Tech / MCA preferred).
* **2–5 years of experience** in .NET development (freshers with strong project experience may also be considered).

**Soft Skills**

* Strong **problem\-solving and analytical skills**
* Good **communication and teamwork abilities**
* Ability to work in **government project environments with deadlines**

Job Type: Contractual / Temporary

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Location:

* Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir (Jammu) (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Cybersecurity Defense Centre Trainee
description:
Job description:

**We are hiring a Cybersecurity Trainee (CDC Trainee)**

**Role Description**

You will work alongside leading cybersecurity domain consultants and technology specialists, supporting mission\-critical insights, solutioning approaches, and research.

You will be groomed into roles focused on:  
Cloud Engineering  
Security Monitoring  
Cyber Risk Management  
Consulting \& Analytics  
Automation

**Skills \& Education Required**

**B**.Tech/M.Tech/MCA/MS\-IT (2021\-2025 pass\-outs only)  
Excellent written and oral communication in English  
Proficiency in MS Office with strong presentation skills  
High attention to detail, inquisitive mindset, and strong problem\-solving ability  
Ability to handle multiple tasks within changing deadlines  
Working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals

**Preferred certifications:**  
CEH, CCNA, CCNP, OSCP, AWS / Azure Associate

**Advantageous experience**:

UNIX/Linux administration  
Scripting (Python, Shell, Perl, etc.)  
Networking (TCP/IP, OSI model)  
Public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)  
Virtualisation / containerisation (VMware, VirtualBox)  
Monitoring tools (Splunk, Nagios, Datadog) or automation tools (Puppet, Chef)  
SIEM, endpoint security, network security

**Additional Details**

You must be open to shift\-based work, as cybersecurity is a 24×7 domain  
Monthly stipend: ₹15,000 during the 6\- to 9\-month trainee program Upon successful completion, and based on performance, you may be offered a permanent Security Analyst role

**Career Path**

You will gain hands\-on experience in monitoring, analytics, and consulting across cybersecurity domains. You' Il work on platforms like Splunk, Palo Alto, IBM, or similar. Top performers can advance to specialized technical or consultant roles.

**Location: Chennai**

**How to Apply: Send your resume to : Faizal@epiqindia.com**

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹8,282\.92 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you a fresher ?
* Are you graduated ?
* Are you willing to work in Rotational shift ?

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
* **Job Role**Position Overview The Field Sales Executive will be responsible for driving residential rooftop solar sales through on\-ground customer engagement, technical site assessments, proposal explanation, and end\-toend customer relationship management. This role demands strong technical knowledge of solar systems, hands\-on rooftop solar experience, excellent communication skills, and the ability to coordinate across sales and operations to ensure timely project completion. The candidate must be comfortable working in the field, conducting multiple visits per day, and handling customers from first interaction to post\-installation support. This role requires mandatory prior experience in residential rooftop solar and a solid understanding of solar technicalities such as system sizing, shadow analysis, basic electrical concepts, inverter selection, and subsidy processes.Key Responsibilities 1\. Lead Handling \& Customer Engagement • Manage leads assigned by Inside Sales/Marketing and schedule prompt site visits. • Educate customers on solar energy, system configuration, components, subsidies, ROI, and long\-term benefits. • Understand customer requirements, load patterns, rooftop space, and budget constraints. • Build trust through technical clarity, transparent pricing explanation, and professional engagement.2\. Technical Site Survey \& Assessment • Conduct rooftop measurements, structural assessments, and shading analysis. • Identify panel placement feasibility, inverter location, cable routing, and potential installation challenges. • Capture detailed site photos and upload all information into the CRM. • Assess whether the site meets safety and technical criteria for installation.3\. Sales Conversion \& Proposal Presentation • Present and explain proposals clearly, covering system size, components, pricing, subsidy eligibility, and payback period. • Handle customer objections using technical accuracy and financial value propositions. • Follow up systematically with warm and hot leads to drive closures. • Achieve monthly kW\-based sales targets.4\. CRM Management \& Documentation • Maintain detailed visit notes, follow\-up reminders, closure stages, and customer requirements in the CRM. • Ensure 100% CRM hygiene through timely updates. • Submit daily reports on visits, pipeline, and closures.5\. Operations Coordination (Post\-Closure) • Handover all closed files to Operations with complete technical details and photos. • Coordinate with operations teams (Survey, Installation, Documentation, Net Metering) to ensure smooth project execution. • Follow up on project status to ensure timely installation and customer satisfaction. • Support operations whenever technical clarifications are needed.6\. Post\-Installation Support \& Customer Experience • Conduct follow\-up calls after installation to ensure system performance and customer satisfaction. • Resolve minor customer queries post\-installation or route them correctly to the operations/service team. • Maintain long\-term relationships with customers to ensure positive brand experience. • Collect testimonials and encourage satisfied customers to provide referrals.7\. Market Insights \& Competitor Tracking • Observe competitor pricing, offers, customer objections, and new market trends. • Share weekly insights with the Sales Manager to improve pitch, pricing strategy, and market positioning.Required Skills \& Qualifications Mandatory Requirements • Minimum 1–3 years of experience in residential rooftop solar sales. • Strong technical understanding of solar PV systems (mandatory). • Ability to explain system design, inverter options, stringing basics, generation expectations, net metering, and subsidy processes. • Experience conducting rooftop assessments and technical site surveys.Core Skills • Excellent communication in local language \+ basic English/Hindi. • Strong customer handling and negotiation capabilities. • Ability to travel extensively for site visits (two\-wheeler required). • Good understanding of solar components: panels, inverters, structures, DC/AC cabling, protections, and installation workflow. • CRM usage knowledge (Solar Ladder preferred). • Ability to manage multiple leads simultaneously with professional follow\-up discipline.Performance KPIs • Monthly kW sold • Lead\-to\-visit ratio • Visit\-to\-closure ratio • CRM update discipline • On\-time project handover to operations • Customer satisfaction after installation • Number of referrals generatedCompensation \& Benefits • Competitive salary \+ attractive performance incentives • Fuel allowance \+ mobile allowance • Training on advanced solar systems, subsidy processes, and company SOPs • Career growth path: Field Sales Executive → Senior Sales Consultant → Team Lead → Area Sales ManagerIdeal Candidate Profile • Hands\-on experience in rooftop solar sales and site surveys • Technically strong, confident, and customer\-centric • High ownership mindset with willingness to go the extra mile • Reliable, disciplined, and capable of working independently on the field

title: Sr. Manager - Employee Relations (International)
description:
**Sr Manager \- Employee Relations (International)**
**﻿﻿About Medline India:**
 Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development Centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1700\+ strong and growing team of technology, finance and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration June 2025 – June 2026\. We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered \& engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
   

  

**About Medline Industries, LP:**
 Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care. At present, Medline Industries, LP, holds the esteemed position as the \#1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centers, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We're proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Employee Relations (ER) Manager will be responsible for strengthening Medline’s International employee relations framework and practice by proactively addressing workplace issues, coaching managers \& employees, ensuring legal compliance, and promoting a culture of openness and fairness.
   

  

 This role will work in close collaboration with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) across all International markets to ensure consistent, timely, and effective handling of people matters and to enable managers to build high\-performing, compliant, and engaged teams.
   

  

 The role will also be accountable for managing investigations into cases raised via EthicsPoint (Medline´s case management system for concerns raised by employees).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Employee Relations \& Compliance Management**
* Act as an advisor to local HR teams on employee relations matters and partner with HRBPs for holistic case handling.
* Conduct fair, thorough, and unbiased investigations into workplace concerns, escalated via EthicsPoint or through other channels, domestic enquiry, grievances, misconduct, or policy violations, in accordance with Medline policy and with adherence to principles of natural justice.
* Maintain detailed case documentation, track trends, and share monthly insights with internal stakeholders.
* Partner with Legal on cases involving significant risk and ensure preventive risk mitigation.
* Liaisons with corporate ER and legal team for reporting and global process alignment
* Support statutory and internal audits related to employee relations, disciplinary actions, and compliance processes.
* Monitor adherence to HR policies and escalate deviations; recommend policy upgrades as needed.
* Manages the templates for formal communications that are outcomes of investigations and provides coaching \& guidance for local HR to complete them appropriately, in line with local requirements
* Provide guidance on the consistent application of disciplinary actions, PIPs, coaching plans, and corrective processes.


**Manager \& HRBP Enablement, Culture \& Process Strengthening**
* Upskill HRBPs and investigators around the management of the International investigation processes to ensure consistency and fairness in process
* Work closely with HRBPs to coach managers on handling performance issues, conflict resolution, conduct concerns, and difficult conversations.
* Build preventive ER capability through manager training, employee awareness sessions, playbooks, checklists, and communication resources.
* Strengthen team\-level trust, psychological safety, and communication by identifying patterns and early\-warning indicators.
* Collaborate with L\&D to embed ER best practices into manager development programs, including the facilitation of upskilling sessions for HR.
* Support HRBPs by reviewing performance documentation, PIP design, and ensuring process robustness.
* Partner with the international HR leadership team to identify, analyse and action plan recurring issues across our markets as an input to our employee relations agenda
* Ensure transparent, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders on ER matters.


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 15 years of experience in Employee Relations roles, with demonstrated capability to operate in multinational organizations
* Experience operating in multiple countries in the context of a global capability center (as a center of expertise that provides corporate guidance and coaching across markets)
* Strong communication skills, with ability to engage at senior leadership level with credibility and impact
* Track record in strong cross functional collaboration, including with Legal and Compliance stakeholders. Coaching, influencing, documentation and follow\-up must be strengths.
* Hands\-on experience in managing investigations and drafting formal legal notices and letters.

Our well\-known banners across the United States, including Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel\-Osco and others, serve more than 36 million U.S customers each week.

 Our success is built on a one\-team approach, driven by the desire to understand and enhance customer experience. By constantly pushing the boundaries of retail, we are transforming shopping into an experience that is easy, efficient, fun and engaging.
 



  





**About Albertsons Companies India:** 




 At Albertsons Companies India, we're not just pushing the boundaries of technology and retail innovation, we're cultivating a space where ideas flourish and careers thrive. Our workplace in India is a vital extension of the Albertsons Companies Inc. workforce and important to the next phase in the company’s technology journey to support millions of customers’ lives every day.
 



 At the Albertsons Companies India, we are raising the bar to grow across Technology \& Engineering, AI, Digital and other company functions, and transform a 165\-year\-old American retailer. At Albertsons Companies India associates collaborate directly with international teams, enhancing decision\-making processes and organizational agility through exciting and pivotal projects. Your work will make history and help millions of lives each day come together around the joys of food and inspire their well\-being.
 



  





**Position Summary:** 




 The Manager – Learning will support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of learning programs for our Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru, India. This role is responsible for implementing learning strategies that build associate capability and drive business performance. The position will manage learning operations and partner closely with global and local stakeholders to ensure programs are relevant, high\-quality, and aligned with enterprise priorities.
 



  





**Role Responsibilities:** 




**Learning Strategy \& Planning:** 



* Partner with global and local HR and business leaders to identify learning priorities, skills gaps, and future capability needs.
* Contribute to the development and execution of the GCC learning roadmap, ensuring alignment with global learning goals.
* Support implementation of enterprise\-wide learning initiatives locally.



  





**Needs Assessment:** 



* Conduct and analyze learning needs assessments using surveys, interviews, and performance data.
* Translate business needs into actionable learning solutions in partnership with subject matter experts and global learning teams.



  





**Program Design \& Development:** 



* Design and develop engaging learning content (digital, instructor\-led, blended) using adult learning principles.
* Create course materials, activities, and assessments using instructional design tools and templates.
* Adapt global content for local audiences while maintaining consistency with brand and quality standards.



  





**Delivery \& Facilitation:** 



* Manage delivery logistics for learning programs, including scheduling, coordination with facilitators, and platform setup.
* Facilitate selected in\-person and virtual learning sessions.
* Ensure a positive and consistent learner experience across programs.



  





**Measurement \& Continuous Improvement:** 



* Collect feedback and evaluate learning program effectiveness using defined metrics.
* Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and enhance learning impact over time.



  





**Operations \& Governance:** 



* Manage learning operations, including vendor coordination, budgeting support, and LMS administration.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy, accessibility, and corporate learning standards.
* Promote awareness and adoption of available learning resources and tools across the GCC.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* We believe the successful candidate has these qualifications and experience:
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field (master’s preferred).
* 5\+ years of experience in corporate learning, with experience managing or coordinating learning initiatives.
* Experience in a global or GCC environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design, adult learning theory, and modern learning technologies.



  





**Key Competencies:** 



* Strong execution focus with the ability to translate learning strategy into action.
* Excellent facilitation and communication skills.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency with learning management systems, digital learning tools (e.g., Articulate Suite), and virtual delivery platforms; experience with Coursera a plus.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Talent Consultant, Lead Executive**
 If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
* You will act as a talent consultant for a business unit and be a key point of contact with leadership on various people engagement related matters.
* You will build a deep understanding of both the business direction and talent related topics to ensure successful implementation of key, high\-touch people process and initiatives.
* You will also partner closely with the other talent function teams to ensure seamless execution of talent initiatives across the business unit.


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as a point of contact for leaders and employees within the business unit
* Drive HR activities for the business units (new initiatives, policies \& strategies)
* Ensure employee engagement, employee satisfaction \& retention for the business unit
* Lead the implementation of engagement initiatives like town halls, and other quarterly meetings
* Work closely with the business unit leads and counsellors on career planning and people development strategies
* Drive attrition analysis for the business and call out any trends through which recommendations can be made to the business to support retention
* Ensure resolution of HR related issues and handle these effectively within the given timeline, involving the Employee Relation Talent function where required or expected
* Accountable for supporting people strategy initiatives and providing development opportunities to build skills and knowledge
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business is delivered in a timely and professional manner
* Responsible for day to day HR activities and perform them with the right quality as per communicated standards
* Support the development and execution of innovative HR programs
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business, for example, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong employee relations experience from handling complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities
* Experience of making contribution to business decision making, strategic planning discussions and operational planning events
* Proven ability to influence leaders in the organisation, preferably in a professional services environment
* Good change management skills and a desire to act as a change agent


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate. A post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 3 \- 5 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g. performance management, employee relations)
* Relevant working experience in delivering / managing talent initiatives


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Comfortable working with data and preparation of summaries/storyboards is preferred


**What We Look For**
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion
* Open to working with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic environment


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Company Description**

The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment and pharmaceutical products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. **Job Description**
**Position Summary:** 
 Eurofins Lancaster Laboratories is seeking a highly analytical and quality‑driven
 **Data Reviewer Specialist** 
 to ensure accuracy and compliance of all stability protocols and study builds prior to client release. This position plays a crucial role in safeguarding data integrity and ensuring that client expectations are consistently met.

 **Stability Protocol Writer / Study Builder**

* Verify compliance with GMP, internal SOPs, and industry guidelines.
* Identify discrepancies, errors, or gaps and communicate effectively with Protocol Writers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to resolve issues.

* Support continuous improvements in review workflows, documentation standards, and system utilization.


**Qualifications**

* Ability to learn and work effectively within LIMS or similar informatics systems.

title: Quality Control Engineer
company: Bhoomi Process Management Pvt Ltd ( sister concern of Bhoomi Analyzers)
description:
**Company Description** 




 Bhoomi Process Management Pvt. Ltd., a sister concern of Bhoomi Analyzers, has been dedicated to manufacturing world\-class products for process industries since its inception in June 2006\. The company specializes in gas and liquid analyzers for applications in Process, Combustion, Emission, and Renewable Energy. Serving over 1,500 clients across sectors like power plants, oil \& refineries, pharmaceuticals, and research institutes, Bhoomi has demonstrated consistent growth exceeding 30% annually. With expertise in advanced technologies such as NDIR, UV\-DOAS, TDLAS, and FTIR, Bhoomi is recognized as a leader in its field and operates under ISO 9001:2015\-certified quality management standards.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Quality Control Engineer located in
 **Ambernath**
 . The Quality Control Engineer will oversee and perform quality control processes to ensure all products meet organizational and industry standards. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting inspections, performing quality assurance tests, analyzing data to identify areas for improvement, and optimizing quality processes. Additionally, the engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams to address quality issues and maintain compliance with industry regulations while supporting the organization’s commitment to excellence.
 



  





**Job location: Ambernath**




  





**Qualifications** 



* Proficiency in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, and Quality Management processes
* Strong Analytical Skills, including data interpretation and problem\-solving
* Effective Communication skills to collaborate with teams and document findings
* Experience in process industries or related fields preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field
* Familiarity with ISO 9001:2015 standards and regulatory compliance



  





**Department:** 
  Quality Control / Quality Assurance
 



**Reporting To:** 
  QC Manager / Quality Head
 



**Qualification:** 
  ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Instrumentation or related field (Freshers can apply)
 



**Experience:** 
  Fresher – 2 Years
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 



* **Incoming \& In\-Process Inspection:** 
  Perform incoming, in\-process, and final inspection of materials and finished products.
* **Testing:** 
  Conduct visual, dimensional, and functional testing as per product specifications.
* **Quality Documentation:** 
  Prepare and maintain inspection reports, test records, and quality documentation.
* **Non\-Conformance Handling:** 
  Raise Non\-Conformance Reports (NCR) for defective materials or products.
* **Corrective Actions:** 
  Support root cause analysis and assist in implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* **ISO Compliance:** 
  Assist in maintaining ISO 9001 documentation and support internal or external audits.
* **Process Compliance:** 
  Ensure all inspection activities follow company SOPs and safety guidelines.
* **Cross\-Team Coordination:** 
  Coordinate with production, stores, and dispatch teams to resolve quality\-related issues.
* **Use of Measuring Instruments:** 
  Utilize measuring instruments such as Vernier, Multimeter, Micrometer, etc., for quality checks.
* **Reporting \& Analysis:** 
  Maintain accurate records and support quality analysis for continuous improvement.



  





**Required Skills:** 



* Basic knowledge of quality control tools and techniques.
* Understanding of measuring instruments (Vernier, Multimeter, Micrometer, etc.).
* Knowledge of ISO 9001 standards.
* Basic MS Excel and documentation skills.
* Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

title: QA Fresher
description:
Job Description

Company: Digipay Guru  
Location: Ahmedabad \- WFO  
Experience:Fresher to 1 year  
Employment Type: Full\-time

**Position Summary**

We are looking for a Junior Quality Analyst hands\-on experience in manual software testing, and who is open to Automation. The ideal candidate will be passionate about ensuring product quality, possess a keen eye for detail, and be eager to learn and grow within a dynamic development team.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Manual Test Execution : Execute detailed test cases and test plans for new features, enhancements, and bug fixes across our SaaS platform (web and/or mobile applications).  
● Defect Identification \& Reporting: Identify, document, and accurately report software defects (bugs) using a bug tracking system, providing clear steps to reproduce, expected results, and actual results.  
● Test Case Creation \& Maintenance: Assist in the creation and maintenance of comprehensive test cases based on functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.  
● Regression Testing: Perform thorough regression testing to ensure that new changes do not negatively impact existing functionalities.  
● Exploratory Testing: Conduct exploratory testing to uncover defects that might be missed by formal test cases, leveraging intuition and creativity.  
● Cross\-Browser/Device Testing: Test applications across various browsers, operating systems, and devices to ensure compatibility and consistent user experience.  
● Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and other QA  
team members to understand requirements, clarify issues, and ensure timely  
delivery of high\-quality software.  
● Feedback \& Communication: Provide clear, concise, and timely feedback on  
product quality and progress to the team.  
● Documentation: Contribute to QA documentation, including test reports and  
knowledge base articles.  
● Continuous Improvement: Participate in team discussions to improve testing  
processes, tools, and overall software quality.

**Qualifications**  
● Prior experience testing applications is highly desirable.  
● Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, principles, and the  
Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).  
● Experience with bug tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello, Bugzilla) and test  
management tools (e.g., TestRail, Zephyr) is a plus.  
● Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development environments.  
● Basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and database  
concepts is a plus.  
● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related  
field, or equivalent practical experience.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹33,000\.00 per month

title: Network Engineer L2
description:
**Job Title: Network Engineer – L3** 
**Role Overview** 
 The Network Engineer L3 is a senior technical role responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and troubleshooting of complex enterprise network infrastructures. This role acts as the highest escalation point for network issues, leads major incidents, drives network architecture improvements, and provides technical guidance to L1/L2 teams.
 **Key Responsibilities** 
**Network Design \& Architecture** 
 Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available network architectures.Lead network upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh initiatives.Define network standards, best practices, and architecture documentation.
 **Advanced Troubleshooting \& Escalations** 
 Act as the final escalation point for complex network incidents and outages.Perform deep\-dive troubleshooting across LAN, WAN, WLAN, Data Center, and cloud networks.Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes.
 **Network Operations \& Optimization** 
 Optimize network performance, availability, and reliability.Monitor network health and proactively address risks and capacity issues.Drive automation and continuous improvement in network operations.
 **Security \& Compliance** 
 Implement and manage network security controls (firewalls, VPNs, ACLs, segmentation).Collaborate with Security teams on threat mitigation and compliance requirements.Ensure adherence to security standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.
 **Cloud \& Hybrid Networking** 
 Design and support cloud and hybrid network connectivity (AWS, Azure, GCP).Implement site\-to\-site VPNs, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, and SD\-WAN solutions.Integrate on\-prem and cloud networking securely and efficiently.
 **Leadership \& Mentoring** 
 Provide technical leadership and mentoring to L1/L2 engineers.Review configurations, change requests, and implementation plans.Act as a subject matter expert (SME) during audits, reviews, and projects.
 **Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 
 Work with network vendors and service providers for issue resolution and design guidance.Evaluate new networking technologies and tools.Coordinate with cross\-functional teams on large initiatives.
 **Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
 7–12 years of experience in enterprise networking.Expert knowledge of:Routing \& Switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, STP)WAN technologies (MPLS, SD\-WAN)Network Security (Firewalls, VPNs, IPS/IDS)Strong experience with Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or similar vendors.Hands\-on experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools.Strong understanding of high availability and disaster recovery designs.
